attributes.board_name: Oklahoma State Board of Medical Licensure and Supervision – Occupational Therapy Advisory Committee

rules.accepted_credit_types: Traditional (1 point per hour): workshops, seminars, conferences, AOTA/OOTA/NBCOT-offered or approved programs, SIS meetings, OTECO workshops; in-services max 6. Alternative: presenting (2 points per hour, first presentation); fieldwork instruction (1 point per week); publications (book up to 20, chapter/journal article up to 10, newsletter up to 10 per period, media 10–20); research (10) and QA studies; college courses (10 points per credit); approved self-study; specialty certification (20, once); AOTA membership (2) and association/committee roles (up to 8 or 4 per year).
rules.audit_note: Random or for-cause audits after each compliance period; audited licensees have 30 days to submit proof electronically. Penalties after notice and hearing may include extra CE hours and fines.
rules.notes: 1 point = 1 contact hour. License renews every year by October 31; the 2-year CE cycle runs November 1 – October 31 and ends October 31 of even-numbered years. Permanent rule amendments posted by the Board ('Eff. 2027') keep the 20 contact hours per 2-year cycle ending October 31 of even years and move CE documentation to electronic submission.
